text: The accepted limitedFPRs filter compares full fingerprints as "0x" + k.fpr during unlock and permanent import. The keyRing wrapper still passes a parameter called limitedUids into that position. Recommend names that state the actual identifier kind when modifying this boundary; inspect callers before renaming the legacy parameter.
